tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience building and supporting enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, and OCC REST APIs, with a proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integration and database performance tuning. Techno-functional professional skilled in requirements analysis, user stories, and AI-assisted delivery. Experienced in CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes, ensuring high-performance, scalable solutions within agile, international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise-grade e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, and headless API integrations to your team.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: I have extensive hands-on experience with SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211, including designing complex product catalogs and order management systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: I bridge the gap between business and IT by translating complex requirements into functional specifications and user stories for seamless platform delivery.

bullets.label: Integration & APIs
bullets.text: I have successfully engineered data pipelines and OCC REST APIs to synchronize PIM, ERP, and MDM systems, ensuring high data consistency across global channels.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Development
bullets.text: I leverage generative AI and LLM tools to accelerate development cycles, documentation, and production troubleshooting, maintaining high code quality and efficiency.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period, with my last working day on 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your goals.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich als SAP Commerce Cloud Developer. Durch meine über fünfjährige Erfahrung bei Rockwell Automation und Shell verfüge ich über fundierte Kenntnisse in Java, Spring und der Entwicklung von Headless-API-Lösungen für komplexe E-Commerce-Plattformen.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Ich verfüge über umfassende praktische Erfahrung mit SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 und 2211, insbesondere bei der Gestaltung von Produktkatalogen und Order-Management-Systemen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Als Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT übersetze ich komplexe Anforderungen präzise in funktionale Spezifikationen und User Stories.

bullets.label: Integration & APIs
bullets.text: Ich habe erfolgreich Datenpipelines und OCC REST APIs implementiert, um PIM-, ERP- und MDM-Systeme effizient zu synchronisieren.

bullets.label: KI-gestützte Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich setze generative KI-Tools gezielt ein, um Entwicklungszyklen, Dokumentationen und das Troubleshooting in der Produktion zu beschleunigen.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und besitze eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein aktuelles Arbeitsverhältnis endet am 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung stehe. Gerne stelle ich mich Ihnen in einem persönlichen Gespräch vor.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to your company because of your commitment to combining AI-driven innovation with engineering excellence. Having worked on large-scale SAP Commerce implementations, I admire your focus on high-quality, scalable e-commerce architecture. I am eager to contribute my techno-functional expertise to your team, helping to bridge the gap between complex business requirements and robust technical delivery in a forward-thinking environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am a SAP-certified developer passionate about building scalable e-commerce platforms. I thrive in techno-functional roles, using Java, Spring, and AI-assisted workflows to solve complex integration challenges and deliver high-value solutions for global enterprises.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I am a SAP-certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I specialize in Java, Spring, and complex PIM/ERP integrations. I am currently looking for new challenges and would love to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over 5 years of experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and a strong background in Java, Spring, and API integrations, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your team. I am currently serving my notice period and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to the possibility of discussing my application with you.
